selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do all kinds of animals and birds agree on together?
questions.answer: They all testify that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: Why does the passage say this witness is strong?
questions.answer: Because it comes from the agreement of many signs all pointing to the same truth.

questions.question: What does the traveler do after seeing this great witness?
questions.answer: He understands its meaning completely.

questions.question: Which creatures are directly mentioned in the formal statement that follows?
questions.answer: Animals and birds are directly mentioned.

questions.question: What do their complete body parts show?
questions.answer: They show careful making and a clear purpose.

questions.question: What do these signs tell us about how animals were made?
questions.answer: They tell us animals were made in an ordered and meaningful way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the differences among animals’ forms?
questions.answer: Their many forms are organized, different from one another, and very varied.

questions.question: Why is it important that many forms come from similar eggs and sperm?
questions.answer: It shows amazing power and planning, since very different creatures come from similar beginnings.

questions.question: How are the many forms of animals described?
questions.answer: They are orderly, different, varied, and beyond counting.

questions.question: If a student had to say the main idea in one sentence, what could they say?
questions.answer: The many ordered and beautiful kinds of animals and birds all show Allah’s power, wisdom, and oneness.

questions.question: What is the main message shared by the three truths mentioned at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Together they show that all animal kinds witness to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What are they testifying to?
questions.answer: They are testifying that there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: Where is this testimony being sent?
questions.answer: It is being conveyed to the dwellers of the heavens.

questions.question: What do their well-arranged senses and powers show?
questions.answer: They show order and meaning in how they were made.

questions.question: What are two kinds of body signs outside animals that are mentioned?
questions.answer: Their limbs and organs are mentioned.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the way animals are created?
questions.answer: It teaches that they are brought into existence by Allah’s will, purpose, and wisdom.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by mentioning decoration and distinction among creatures?
questions.answer: It suggests that their beauty and differences are intentional, not random.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the shaping of creatures?
questions.answer: Their forms and measurements are made with wisdom.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention similar eggs and sperm?
questions.answer: To show that many different creatures come from simple and similar starting points.

questions.question: What main lesson should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: All creation, even animals and birds, points people to Allah through its order, design, and variety.

questions.question: Who is said to be testifying together in this passage?
questions.answer: All the different species of animals are testifying together.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare the earth to a great human being?
questions.answer: To show that all the creatures on earth seem to join into one huge testimony.

questions.question: What are animals and birds doing toward Allah in the passage?
questions.answer: They are praising Him and showing proof of Him.

questions.question: What are two kinds of signs inside animals that are mentioned?
questions.answer: Their senses and powers are mentioned.
